name: Eiffel
typeSystem: Static and strong. Design by Contract is integrated into the language through preconditions, postconditions, and class invariants; these are executable assertions and interface specifications rather than types or ordinary method-signature components.
runtime: Compiled ahead-of-time with automatic garbage collection. EiffelStudio's finalized and frozen builds generate C and invoke a C compiler to produce native code.

runtimes.name: Native (via C, EiffelStudio)
runtimes.role: EiffelStudio compiles Eiffel through generated C down to native machine code.

compilers.name: EiffelStudio
compilers.role: The reference IDE and compiler, from Eiffel Software.

concurrencyModel: SCOOP (Simple Concurrent Object-Oriented Programming) uses the separate type annotation to model objects handled by other processors. In specific calling and locking contexts, preconditions containing separate calls act as wait conditions; other contract clauses retain their correctness-checking role.

codeExample.caption: Hello, World!
codeExample.source:
class
    HELLO
create
    make
feature
    make
        do
            print("Hello, World!%N")
        end
end
